noteEs.usage: Término informático; configuration update/error; verbo configure.

noteHi.meaning: किसी प्रणाली की सेटिंग्स और व्यवस्था।
noteHi.usage: आईटी शब्द; configuration update/error; क्रिया configure।

contended.ex: He contended that the law was unfair.

noteKo.exampleTr: 도로 공사로 교통에 큰 혼란이 생겼다.

paragraphs: A big problem hit Microsoft on Thursday evening. Many people around the world could not use Outlook email or Teams. Word, Excel and PowerPoint also had problems. People in Ireland had trouble too.

Businesses, schools, courts and government offices could not work well. Even Microsoft workers could not send emails for more than nine hours. On a website called Down Detector, there were almost 130,000 reports at about 6pm.
The problem lasted more than 12 hours. By 2am on Friday, Teams was working again. Most of the trouble was now with email.

Microsoft says a change to its computer settings caused the problem. Too many servers stopped working. It says there was no attack. An expert says companies should test changes first. They should also have a second email service.

到了週五凌晨2點，Teams恢復運作。

一位專家說，公司應該先測試更改。

paragraphs: A major Microsoft 365 outage hit users around the world, including Ireland, from Thursday evening until Friday morning. People could not use Outlook email properly, and Teams chats and meetings stopped working. Word, Excel and PowerPoint were also affected.

Possibly millions of people had problems. Businesses, government offices, local councils, courts and schools all found it hard to work. Even Microsoft's own staff could not send emails for more than nine hours. The website Down Detector showed a sudden rise in reports at around 6pm on Thursday, with nearly 130,000 complaints.
The outage lasted for more than 12 hours. By 2am on Friday, Microsoft said most of the problem was with Exchange, its Outlook email service. Teams meetings and chats were working again.

Microsoft said an update to its settings seemed to overload its servers and knock them offline. Its first fixes did not work well, because servers stopped responding when traffic came back. So the company limited traffic and moved some servers back to older settings. Microsoft said there was no sign of a cyberattack, but it has not explained why the problem lasted so long.
Mark Gregory, an associate professor at RMIT University, said organisations should test updates carefully before using them. They should also have a backup, such as another email service.

paragraphs: A global outage of Microsoft 365 disrupted work for potentially millions of users from Thursday evening into Friday morning. Outlook email, Teams chats and meetings, and the Word, Excel and PowerPoint apps were all hit, with users around the world, including in Ireland, reporting problems.

Businesses, government agencies, councils, courts and schools were among those affected. Microsoft's own employees were unable to send email for more than nine hours. The monitoring site Down Detector recorded a sharp spike at around 6pm on Thursday, with close to 130,000 reports.

The disruption lasted more than 12 hours. By 2am on Friday, Microsoft had narrowed most of the problem down to Exchange, the service behind Outlook email, and Teams meetings and chats had been restored.

According to Microsoft, a configuration update appears to have overloaded servers and knocked them offline. Early attempts at a fix left returning servers unresponsive as traffic built up again, so the company limited traffic and rolled some servers back to an earlier configuration. Microsoft said there was no evidence of a cyberattack, although it has yet to explain why the outage went on for so long.

Mark Gregory, an associate professor at RMIT University, said organisations should test updates thoroughly before rolling them out. He added that they should keep backup options, such as an alternative email service.

監測網站Down Detector記錄到週四下午6點左右回報數急遽飆升，接近13萬則。
這次中斷持續了超過12個小時。
到了週五凌晨2點，微軟已把大部分問題鎖定在Outlook電子郵件背後的服務Exchange，Teams的會議和聊天也已恢復。
根據微軟的說法，一次組態更新似乎讓伺服器超載並使其離線。
早期的修復嘗試在流量再度增加時，讓重新上線的伺服器失去回應，因此公司限制流量，並將部分伺服器回復到較早的組態。
微軟表示沒有證據顯示遭到網路攻擊，不過尚未解釋這次當機為何持續這麼久。
皇家墨爾本理工大學副教授馬克·葛雷戈里表示，各機構在推出更新前應徹底測試。
他補充說，他們應保留備用選項，例如替代的電子郵件服務。

paragraphs: Millions of people may have been left stranded when Microsoft 365 suffered a sweeping global outage that stretched from Thursday evening into Friday morning. Outlook email, Teams chats and meetings, and the Word, Excel and PowerPoint applications all faltered, with users across the globe, Ireland included, caught up in the disruption.

The fallout spread well beyond ordinary offices, hampering businesses, government agencies, councils, courts and schools. In an awkward twist, Microsoft's own workforce was unable to send email for upwards of nine hours. Down Detector registered a dramatic surge at roughly 6pm on Thursday, when complaints peaked at almost 130,000.

The outage dragged on for more than 12 hours. By 2am on Friday, Microsoft had pinpointed Exchange, the engine behind Outlook email, as the main culprit, while Teams meetings and chats were back up and running.

The trouble seemingly stemmed from a configuration update that overwhelmed servers and knocked them offline. Initial remedies backfired: servers coming back online buckled as traffic flooded back, prompting Microsoft to throttle traffic and revert some machines to an earlier configuration. The company insisted there was no hint of a cyberattack, yet it has offered no explanation for why the outage proved so protracted.

Mark Gregory, an associate professor at RMIT University, argued that organisations ought to test updates rigorously before deploying them, and should keep fallback arrangements in place, such as an alternative email provider.
sentZh: 微軟365發生大範圍全球當機，從週四晚上一路延續到週五早上，可能讓數百萬人陷入困境。
Outlook電子郵件、Teams聊天與會議，以及Word、Excel和PowerPoint應用程式全都運作失靈，全球用戶，包括愛爾蘭在內，都被捲入這場混亂。
影響遠遠超出一般辦公室，企業、政府機關、議會、法院和學校都受到阻礙。
尷尬的是，微軟自己的員工也有九個多小時無法寄送電子郵件。
Down Detector在週四下午6點左右記錄到劇烈激增，投訴數最高達到將近13萬則。
這次當機拖了超過12個小時。
到了週五凌晨2點，微軟已確定Outlook電子郵件背後的引擎Exchange是主要禍首，而Teams的會議和聊天則已恢復正常運作。
問題似乎源自一次組態更新，它讓伺服器不堪負荷並使其離線。
最初的補救措施適得其反：流量湧回時，重新上線的伺服器撐不住，促使微軟壓低流量，並將部分機器還原到較早的組態。
公司堅稱沒有任何網路攻擊的跡象，但對於當機為何拖得這麼久卻未提出任何解釋。
皇家墨爾本理工大學副教授馬克·葛雷戈里主張，各機構在部署更新前應嚴格測試，並應備妥後備安排，例如替代的電子郵件供應商。

paragraphs: A substantial global outage affecting Microsoft 365 disrupted the working lives of potentially millions of users from Thursday evening until Friday morning. Core services, including Outlook email, Teams messaging and meetings, and the Word, Excel and PowerPoint applications, were rendered unreliable for users worldwide, including those in Ireland.

The consequences were far-reaching, extending to businesses, government agencies, councils, courts and educational institutions. Notably, Microsoft's own personnel were unable to send email for in excess of nine hours. Data from Down Detector indicated a pronounced spike at approximately 6pm on Thursday, at which point reports reached almost 130,000.

In total, the disruption persisted for more than 12 hours. By 2am on Friday, Microsoft had attributed the majority of the remaining difficulties to Exchange, its Outlook email service, whereas Teams meetings and chats had been fully restored.

The incident appears to have originated in a configuration update which overloaded servers and consequently took them offline. Preliminary fixes proved counterproductive, since restored servers became unresponsive as traffic returned; Microsoft therefore restricted traffic and reverted certain servers to a previous configuration. Although the company stated that there was no indication of a cyberattack, it has nevertheless failed to account for the prolonged duration of the outage.

Mark Gregory, an associate professor at RMIT University, contended that the reliability of such systems is contingent upon rigorous testing prior to deployment. He further recommended that organisations maintain contingency measures, such as an alternative email service.

其後果影響深遠，波及企業、政府機關、議會、法院和教育機構。
值得注意的是，微軟自己的員工超過九個小時無法寄送電子郵件。
Down Detector的資料顯示，週四下午約6點出現明顯高峰，當時回報數達到將近13萬則。
整體而言，這次中斷持續了超過12個小時。
到了週五凌晨2點，微軟已將剩餘的大部分問題歸因於其Outlook電子郵件服務Exchange，而Teams的會議和聊天已完全恢復。
這起事件似乎源於一次組態更新，它使伺服器超載，因而導致伺服器離線。

雖然公司表示沒有遭到網路攻擊的跡象，但它仍未能說明這次當機為何持續如此之久。
皇家墨爾本理工大學副教授馬克·葛雷戈里主張，這類系統的可靠性取決於部署前的嚴格測試。
他進一步建議各機構採取應變措施，例如替代的電子郵件服務。
